jobs.occupation: Technical Sales Manager (m/f/d) in Bayern - Robotics (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description: OUR CHALLENGEFilics entwickelt autonome mobile Roboter für die Intralogistik. Die Nachfrage ist groß, gerade in Bayern und Österreich. Daher suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Verstärkung, um aus dieser Nachfrage konkrete Kundenprojekte zu machen. Du bist überwiegend bei unseren Kunden vor Ort und demonstrierst unsere Roboter direkt in ihrer Betriebsumgebung.DEINE ROLLE• Technische Demos mit unseren Robotern direkt beim Kunden durchführen• Kunden vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Abschluss begleiten• Filics auf Messen und Branchenevents vertreten• Marktfeedback ins Team und den Vertriebsansatz einbringenDAS BRINGST DU MIT• Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb von Robotik, Automatisierungstechnik oder Sensorik• Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung und beim Aufbau einer Region• Hands-on-Mentalität und Interesse, unsere Technologie wirklich zu verstehen• Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch• Hohe Reisebereitschaft, du bist überwiegend beim KundenDAS BIETEN WIR DIR• Dienstwagen• Jährliches Lernbudget und Karriere, die mit Filics wächst• Möglichkeit zur Mitarbeiterbeteiligung• 30 Urlaubstage und EGYM Wellpass• Ein modernes Büro für die Tage, an denen du nicht beim Kunden bistÜber unsFilics’ mission is to reinvent intralogistics by creating autonomous mobile robots that fundamentally change how material moves. Our double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR able to drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets, breaking forklift logic and setting a new standard for efficiency. We are a small, focused team committed to solving hard problems with engineering excellence. All team members are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All team members are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!Join us to build up one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in Dresden.As a Quality Control Technician you serve as the final quality gate before our products reach global customers.In this role, you combine automated optical inspection (AVI), systematic defect review, and final documentation checks in a cutting-edge cleanroom facility. During your onboarding starting in February 2027, you will complete a 6-month training program in Taiwan to gain hands-on fab experience, master core inspection procedures, and build a strong international network.Job Responsibilities• Operate optical inspection tools and manage Automated Visual Inspection recipes.• Perform detailed defect reviews, verify hold lots, and generate structured defect reports for engineering evaluation.• Validate outgoing wafer documentation and ensure strict compliance with quality, handling, and shipping standards.• Execute cleanroom environmental monitoring and support routine tool calibration and 6S audit processes.• Conduct initial troubleshooting on inspection equipment and execute lot disposition according to standard procedures.• Manage operational inventory of cleanroom parts, consumables, and Front Opening Shipping Boxes.• Handle manual packing and safe dispatch preparation of finished goods for warehouse transfer.• Work in rotating shift schedules (initially a 2-shift model, transitioning to a continuous 5-crew 3-shift roster).Your profile Must Have:• Completed technical vocational training (Berufsausbildung) or equivalent with technical background/aptitude.• Hands-on experience in manufacturing, production, or quality inspection environments. Semiconductor experience is a plus, but motivated entry-level candidates and cross-industry applicants are welcome).• Willingness to work in a cleanroom environment (90%), covering physical material handling as well as stationary desk-based analysis.• Readiness to work rotating shifts.• Solid PC literacy (MS Office, especially Excel).• Professional English proficiency (min. B2) and at least basic German language skills.• Availability for onboarding in February 2027, including the 6-month training in Tainan, Taiwan.Nice to Have:• Prior experience in cleanroom environments, semiconductor manufacturing, or precision industries (e.g., optics, electronics, medical technology).• Basic understanding of defect inspection systems, statistical process control, or 6S principles.• Mandarin language skills (beneficial for cross-site collaboration).Reasons to join ESMC• Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.• Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).• Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden.• Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you continuously expand your knowledge.• Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit.• Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket).Application documentsPlease apply with your English CV.About usEach journey starts with a first step.Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC).We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to reach your full potential.At ESMC, we welcome applications from all people, regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity.
